updates on VV:

8_1: fixed Temperature and added ekin to _dipol_moment.out

8_2: changed method argument from value to array method=[calc_method, qc_method]
calc_method = QC-Programm (Gaussian, qchem, ect.)
qc_method = Funktional (MP2, CCSD, wB97XD, ect.)

8_3: thermostate parameter added:
berensen = [Enable, T_soll]
enable_thermostate = True
Note: something about the v scaling with the enabled thermostate seems to go wrong 
(Ekin+Epot differs more and seems to diverge when enabled) - find the error and maybe fix it in previous version

8_4: hard coded constants to scipy.constants

8_5: add bagel for dynamic option (and run it for check) (qchem for later) # not finished

8_6: add orca for dynamic option
